note: Fish Creek State Park (largest state park in western MT), up Fish Creek Rd off I-90 Exit 66 near Alberton. Developed camping is at the Big Pine FWP fishing-access site within the park (site of the area's largest known ponderosa pine), with fire rings and tables (state conservation stamp required); additional drive-in dispersed sites along Fish Creek Rd, a few fitting larger rigs. Big rigs should follow the signed route, not GPS over the mountain. --Claude
